$comment: Multi-forge registry per docs/MULTI_FORGE_ARCHITECTURE.md §3. JSON, not the YAML sketched in that doc's prose -- every other file in core/config/ is JSON and this avoids adding a PyYAML dependency for one file. canonical_forge is the single source of truth for governance (PRs/issues/collaboration); mirrors are read-only replicas, never a second place to push to.

mirrors.note: url is null until anh provisions the GitLab project and fills it in -- see docs/GITLAB_MIRROR_SETUP.md. direction=pull means GitLab's own Pull Mirroring feature fetches from GitHub; GitHub Actions and its secrets are untouched (no GitLab credential exists on the GitHub side).
